articles.title: Australia: Indian Army's Col Prateek Roy receives Geddes Gavel Award
articles.summary: Colonel Prateek Roy of the Indian Army was honoured with the prestigious Geddes Gavel Award upon completing the Defence Strategic and Studies Course at the Australian Defence College. This achievement, announced by the Indian High Commission in Canberra, highlights the Indian Army's professional excellence and deepens India's defence ties with Australia, showcasing the calibre of Indian officers on international platforms.

articles.title: India unveils indigenous long-range attack DRONES powered by homegrown Wankel engines
articles.summary: India is indigenously developing long-range attack drones, powered by advanced Wankel rotary engines. This strategic initiative aims to significantly reduce reliance on foreign suppliers, thereby bolstering India's defence capabilities and enhancing strategic autonomy. The project involves collaboration between state-owned NAL and private sector entities, marking a crucial step towards self-reliance in cutting-edge defence technology for national security.
